About.title: About
About.lead: Organic architecture shaped by place, landscape, and experience.
About.p1: Santiago Architecture is an international architecture and design studio founded by Gerardo Santiago Pineda.
About.p2: We work with private clients, developers, and investors on residences, villas, hospitality projects, and larger-scale developments.
About.p3: Our process combines architectural design, construction knowledge, spatial exploration, and advanced 3D modeling, allowing us to carry projects from early concepts toward realization.
About.p4: We aim to create architecture with its own identity: contemporary, sensitive to context, and designed to be experienced.
About.approach1: We do not understand architecture as an isolated object. Every project begins with place: its climate, landscape, light, vegetation, materials, and ways of living.
About.approach2: Three-dimensional modeling is part of the design process from the earliest stages, allowing us to explore spaces, geometries, and relationships that could hardly be developed in plan alone.
About.portfolioBody: Download a selection of our projects and explore our approach to design.

Services.title: Services
Services.lead: From the first idea through construction.
Services.intro: We design and develop projects of every scale for private clients, developers, and investors internationally.
Services.closing: We design architecture and carry it through to realization.

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.body: We develop projects from the initial concept through full architectural definition, integrating function, materiality, landscape, and spatial experience.

designBuild.title: Design + Build
designBuild.body: We take the project from design through execution, preserving the architectural intent throughout and coordinating the teams needed to make it real.

residential.title: Residential
residential.body: We design singular residences shaped by place, the client's way of living, and the specific conditions of each site.

hospitality.title: Hospitality
hospitality.body: We design hotels, resorts, villas, and hospitality spaces where architecture, landscape, and experience belong to one shared vision.

masterplan.title: Masterplanning
masterplan.body: We develop master plans for large-scale projects, integrating architecture, landscape, circulation, views, privacy, amenities, and future growth within a cohesive strategy.

development.title: Development & Investment
development.body: We work with developers and investors to turn land and real-estate opportunities into projects with identity, defining their architectural vision and spatial strategy.

largeScale.title: Large-scale Development
largeScale.body: We work on larger territorial and investment-driven projects, aligning architecture, landscape, and growth strategy.

residential.title: Homes shaped by their place.
residential.lead: We design distinctive residences around landscape, climate, materiality and the way you want to live. From the first idea through architectural development, every project begins with its site.
residential.approachBody: Each residence begins with the specific conditions of its setting—landscape, climate, light, vegetation and materiality—and develops around the way its inhabitants want to live.

hospitality.title: Architecture for destinations with identity.
hospitality.lead: We work with owners, developers and investors on boutique hospitality, resorts and larger-scale developments where architecture, landscape and guest experience are developed as one strategy.

Consent.title: Your privacy choices
Consent.body: We use essential browser storage for your preferences. With your permission, Meta Pixel helps us understand visits and successful project inquiries.
Consent.necessaryBody: Required to remember your privacy choice and support core website functionality.
Consent.marketingBody: Allows Meta Pixel to measure page visits and confirmed project inquiries. It stays blocked unless you enable it.

Privacy.title: Privacy & Cookies
Privacy.lead: Clear choices about optional marketing technology.
Privacy.intro: Santiago Architecture uses limited browser storage to remember your privacy preferences. Optional marketing tracking remains off unless you explicitly allow it.
Privacy.essentialBody: A preference record is stored in your browser so the website can remember whether you accepted or rejected marketing tracking. This record is necessary for the consent system and does not contain contact-form information.
Privacy.marketingBody: If you grant marketing consent and tracking is enabled, Meta Pixel helps us understand visits to English and Spanish pages and whether a project inquiry was successfully received. Meta may process technical information such as IP address, browser or device information, page URL, referral information, and event time. Contact-form fields are not included in browser Pixel event parameters.
Privacy.controlBody: You can accept marketing tracking, reject non-essential tracking, or manage your preference. You can change or revoke your choice at any time using the Cookie preferences control. Revocation prevents further Meta PageView and Lead events from this website.
Privacy.activationBody: Meta Pixel loads only when both conditions are met: you have granted marketing consent and the website's production tracking flag is enabled. Rejecting marketing tracking does not affect access to the website or contact form.
